lines: Mora ang ang
couplets.en: Every part of me.

lines: Mora ang ang nav rang ranga kyun, rasiya?
couplets.en: Why have you dyed every part of me a new hue, my love?

lines: Mohe janam janam ke liye salona dard diya kyun, rasiya?
